companies.verdict: Exceptional innovator and plausible scale-up candidate
companies.top_innovation_domain: Liver-targeted RNAi therapeutics and GalNAc/LNP delivery
companies.main_red_flag: TTR concentration: AMVUTTRA and the TTR franchise dominate the current adoption signal; a slowdown in ATTR-CM penetration, payer support or competitive dynamics would matter disproportionately.

companies.top_innovation_domain: CNP/FGFR3 skeletal dysplasia platform including VOXZOGO, BMN 333, and CANOPY
companies.main_red_flag: Regulatory success did not equal adoption: ROCTAVIAN's global withdrawal after FDA approval is the largest innovation red flag in the run.

companies.top_innovation_domain: JAK/STAT modulation across myeloproliferative neoplasms, GVHD, atopic dermatitis, vitiligo, HS, and PN
companies.main_red_flag: Jakafi patent cliff: Incyte states Jakafi revenues are expected to begin declining once patent exclusivity expires in 2028; the pipeline must compensate for a very large revenue base.

companies.top_innovation_domain: Single-strand antisense oligonucleotide chemistry and target design
companies.main_red_flag: Patent-count proxy is not family-normalized: The five-year IP trend uses public application/grant listings, not a de-duplicated INPADOC/DOCDB family export.
